_comment: Clean-ups that go with the 2026-11 SARAS expansion, keyed by CBSE affiliation number so they apply to any database (local or live). deactivate: lapsed second listings of a school CBSE lists twice (the listing with the current affiliation period is kept). renames: schools whose name repeated in their district, now named by a place from their own address (saras-name-overrides.json). merge: a curated profile (no affiliation number) and the board-list twin the import created; the twin's affiliation number moves to the curated record and the twin is deleted (LocalMergeDuplicates locally; expansion-2026-11-live.sql on the live database). Applied locally on 2026-11-13.
